name: Hipparcos
summary: Historical ESA space-astrometry mission whose stellar parallaxes and motions help estimate total mass and dark-matter density near the Sun.
detection_principle: Precision astrometry combined with stellar-dynamical models compares vertical motions with visible-matter mass to infer local dark matter.

sites.name: Earth transfer orbit; did not reach the originally planned geostationary orbit
sites.location: Earth transfer orbit; did not reach the originally planned geostationary orbit

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: Science observations ended in 1993-03; final satellite operations ended on 1993-08-15. These dates must not be confused.

results.summary: Dynamical reanalyses emphasize the sensitivity of local-dark-matter density to assumptions about stellar-velocity distributions and to systematic errors.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
